subject.statement: Vijay Mallya was the owner of Kingfisher Airlines.

summary: Vijay Mallya founded and chaired Kingfisher Airlines, effectively owning it during its operational years until its collapse in 2012. The claim uses past tense, which accurately reflects his historical ownership.
